services.text: Services Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its listed inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. The October reading of +10.1 is above its five-year norm, easing from +10.5 a month earlier but up from +7.4 three months ago and -21.5 six months ago; QLD coal saleable tonnes is the largest positive contributor (+11.0), while NSW coal export value is the largest negative (-8.4). ABS mining capex expectations is unavailable and excluded, leaving 80% of input weight available.

products.text: Products Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of selected inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. The latest reading is +36.7, above its five-year norm. It has risen from +35.7 a month ago and +10.7 six months ago, led by US new orders for iron and steel mills (+25.0 contribution), while inverted AUD/USD is the largest negative contributor (-8.7).

margin.text: Margin Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of fitter/welder vacancy tightness and AUD/USD against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. The latest reading of -14.4 is below its five-year norm, but has improved from -16.7 a month ago and -24.1 three months ago. AUD/USD is the largest negative contributor (-20.2), while fitter/welder vacancy tightness is the largest positive contributor (+5.9); the tungsten policy proxy is excluded because it lacks sufficient five-year history.

technology.text: The pipeline holds 2 leads, 6 agreements, 1 cell ordered and 4 commissioned cells, with $7.2 million in stated contracted value, all unrecognised where stated. Over the past six months, it added these positions, including Komatsu’s $2.4 million first licensing agreement and operational first cell, a second Komatsu agreement and cell order, and a Metal 7 collaboration agreement.
